content.text: O aluno grava (celular) e o professor marca ✔ (claro) ou ✘ (precisa treino).
1 comfortable · 2 development · 3 three · 4 this · 5 thought · 6 university · 7 environment · 8 world · 9 photographer · 10 career

My university is about thirty minutes from my house.
The economy has developed rapidly over the last three years.
I'd like to work as a photographer in a big city.
It's comfortable, but it's not very cheap.
Ouçam juntos a gravação. Para cada ✘, o professor modela e o aluno repete 3 vezes; depois regrava.
